svg.text: STAGE 513 · TOPIC 153 · P1019–P1020 🎉 · SVG 157 · 155th FAQ 🎉 · 🎉 HISTORIC 80th ROUND, P1020, 155th FAQ & 955-TEST MILESTONE!
SIP RFC 6086 / RFC 3261 Info-Package 469 Rejection & Overlapping CSeq Serialization Guard
⛔ Vulnerable SIP INFO Path (Prompt Injection & CSeq Desync)
1. Unnegotiated Mid-Call INFO Control-Plane Injection
INFO (No Recv-Info match) + Body: {"vip_auth": true}
• Legacy RFC 2976 parser accepts unadvertised INFO packages
• Injects untrusted metadata directly into AI Voice Agent prompt!
2. Overlapping INFO Transactions & Out-of-Order CSeq 500 Drops
Concurrent CSeq 101..106 over UDP -> 104 arrives before 103
• Violates RFC 6086 §4.2.1 single in-flight INFO transaction rule
• UAS rejects CSeq 103 with 500, scrambling customer PIN/OTP digits!
3. Unbounded 150 req/s In-Dialog INFO Flood DoS
150 INFO req/s per dialog -> B2BUA transaction table exhaustion
• Starves BYE / re-INVITE signaling threads on voice gateway
• Causes call teardown timeouts & zombie RTP media sessions
✅ Deterministic RFC 6086 Guardrails (P1019 + P1020 🎉)
P1019 (1,028th Guardrail): Recv-Info Allowlist & 469 Rejection
action: "reject_unnegotiated_info_package_with_469_and_cap_recv_info"
• Rejects unnegotiated Info-Package with 469 Bad Info Package
• clampedUnnegotiatedInfoRequestsAccepted = 0 (zero prompt injection)
• clampedAllowedRecvInfoPackagesPerDialog in [1, 4] packages
Policy: P1019-SIP-RFC6086-INFO-PACKAGE-NEGOTIATION-AND-469-REJECTION-GUARD
P1020 🎉 (80th Round, P1020, 155th FAQ & 955 Tests!): Serial CSeq Lock
action: "serialize_info_transactions_and_clamp_info_rate_per_sec"
• Enforces RFC 6086 §4.2.1 single in-flight INFO transaction rule
• clampedOutOfOrderOverlappingInfoTransactions = 0 (100% PIN order)
• clampedMaxSipInfoRequestsPerSecond in [1, 10] req/s
Policy: P1020-SIP-RFC6086-INFO-RATE-PACING-AND-OVERLAPPING-CSEQ-GUARD
